enchantments.tooltip: +15 Enhancement Bonus: +15 enhancement bonus to attack and damage rolls.
Keen: Passive: The base critical threat range of this weapon is doubled. This does not stack with Improved Critical feat. Vorpal Strikes by this weapon also bypass all Fortification.
Stabbing 15: The edges of this weapon are serrated, dealing an additional 15d6 piercing damage on each critical hit.
Anarchic 6: On Hit: 6 to 24 Chaos damage. Chaos-aligned creatures are immune to this effect.Penalty: If equipped by a Lawful user, they receive 1 Negative Level for as long as this item is equipped.
